HediffDef.label: Frequency Bleed
HediffDef.description: Forces an unstable mutation on this person. This mutation will activate a new random gene for 12 hours. After that period passes, the gene will deactivate.\n3 new xenogenes will be activated. If the xenogene is converted to an endogene, it will persist.

HediffDef.label: Spectrum Interference
HediffDef.description: Every 24 hours, a massive wave of external static sweeps through the host's sequence, washing away the previous day's aberrations and forcing a completely new, randomized suite of xenogenes into active expression.\n12 new xenogenes will be activated each day. If the xenogene is converted to an endogene, it will persist.
